lead: GnomeVPN builds a tunnel to a node in another country. From the outside it looks like ordinary HTTPS. No logs, no ads, no traffic caps.
cta: Try it free for a day

how.title: How it works
how.step1Body: A full day of access with no card. Then a subscription from {price} ₽ a month: pay by card through YooKassa, turn auto-renewal off in one click.
how.step2Body: A free app from your own store: iPhone, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, TV. We neither build it nor charge for it.
how.step3Body: One link from your account and the app fills up with every server on every protocol: Hysteria2, VLESS + Reality and WireGuard. The list keeps itself up to date.

features.title: What you get
features.protocolBody: Hysteria2 over QUIC leads, because it holds up better on mobile networks. Where UDP is blocked outright the list also carries VLESS + Reality over TCP, and WireGuard for those who prefer it — one tap away.
features.devicesBody: Phone and computer at the same time on one subscription. Need more? Add device places in your account.
features.platformsBody: iPhone, Mac, Android, Windows, Linux, Android TV and Apple TV. The same link works on all of them.
features.locationsBody: Switch country in one tap at no extra cost. New nodes appear in the app on their own.
features.noLogsBody: We keep no connection history and none of the addresses you open. All that remains per device is the time it was last active — so it can be shown in your device list.
features.openFormatBody: The subscription format is standard: paste it into Hiddify, Streisand or v2rayNG. You are locked into neither the app nor us.

platforms.title: Where it runs
platforms.iosBody: INCY from the App Store. The same subscription works on Mac and Apple TV.
platforms.androidBody: INCY from Google Play. Add the subscription with the "Open in INCY" button in your account on the phone.
platforms.windowsBody: An .exe installer. It only asks for admin rights while installing.
platforms.macosBody: A .dmg installer for Macs on Apple Silicon (M1 and later).
platforms.linuxBody: A .deb package for Ubuntu, Debian and their derivatives.
platforms.tvBody: INCY for Android TV and Apple TV. The subscription is added by scanning a QR code from your phone — no typing with a remote.

comparison.title: Why not a free VPN
comparison.speedHint: A node is not shared with thousands of people at once
comparison.adsHint: Free services have to earn from something
comparison.blockingHint: Hysteria2 hides as ordinary HTTPS traffic
comparison.limitsHint: No gigabyte limits and no evening slowdown

guarantee.title: Cancel in one click
guarantee.body: Turn renewal off whenever you like — access stays until the end of the paid period. No phone calls, no emails to support.

meta.title: GnomeVPN — a fast Hysteria2 VPN
meta.description: A VPN on the Hysteria2 protocol: it works where the others are blocked. Servers in several countries, one link for every device.
